accessibility_and_language_note: Use readable layout, plain language, accessible downloadable variants where offered, and translated/community-language variants where maintained. Keep print artifacts aligned with the current FAQ/help page and hotline/help route.
delivery_role_note: Printable and downloadable voter-information artifacts are portable delivery lanes. Action-changing guidance must identify an edition or issue date and point back to the current official page, notice, FAQ/help article, or office-help path that controls the answer.

edition_and_scope_policy.plain_language_role_statement: This handout summarizes and routes. The linked official page, notice, FAQ/help article, or office instruction controls.

print_material_family_label: Example State official voter-information print materials
stale_stock_retirement_note: When locations, deadlines, or procedures materially change, front desks and partner distributors should remove or clearly stale-mark older handouts and replace them with the superseding edition.
